facts: Install 1DPC and run SST memory stress for 12 hours.
Expect no SST/BMC/event errors, hang or blue screen; machine time 240 minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO due to chamber/rail/DIMM physical work.
source_snapshot.v2: MANUAL ONLY with condensation, 1DPC map and ECC evidence.

original_test_intent.statement: Stress all DIMMs in the required 1DPC population for 12 hours at 0 C/+5% rail margin and detect memory or system instability.
must_preserve: All installed DIMMs, 1DPC, 0 C, +5%, 12 hours and no errors/hang.
unknowns: Socket/channel/slot population map, usable memory coverage, SST profile and timing conflict.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It does not demand quantitative address-range coverage or explicitly reconcile four-hour metadata.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep qualified physical setup; prove every 1DPC slot and usable range participates for the full 12 hours.

revision_candidate.test_name: Stress All 1DPC DIMMs at 0 C and +5% Rail Margin
revision_candidate.purpose: Exercise the approved fraction/ranges of all populated 1DPC memory for 12 hours under cold overvoltage and verify zero disallowed ECC, application or platform faults.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact CPU/memory topology and supported DIMMs in calibrated 0 C/+5% conditions with condensation controls.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every signed socket/channel/DIMM slot in the 1DPC population and the owner-defined usable memory range, excluding reserved memory.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Population map, DIMM serials, SST profile/memory fraction, 12-hour/240-minute resolution, CE/UE policy, temperature/rail/condensation limits and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Operator powers down and installs/maps DIMMs, stabilizes safely, then agent may run approved memory stress with per-socket/DIMM telemetry and preserved baseline/delta logs.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Memory topology/capacity match recipe; warm-up/condensation and OOB recovery are ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Slot/serial/channel map; SMBIOS/EDAC capacity; exact SST settings and memory coverage; 12-hour output; CE/UE/MCA/SEL/kernel/temperature/rail trace; photos and controlled warm-up/restoration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Complete required coverage with zero owner-disallowed memory/tool/platform errors and no hang/BSOD.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No hot DIMM handling, log clearing, reduced slot/range/time coverage, or operation with condensation.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Qualified operator handles DIMMs/environment; memory owner approves population and ECC policy.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Physical installation/environment are manual; workload collection may be supervised automation.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop stress, warm and restore nominal rails, verify memory inventory/ECC/host health and preserve errors.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Topology mismatch, moisture, DIMM disappearance, CE/UE threshold, MCA/SEL fault, hang/BSOD or fixture drift.

reason_for_change: All DIMMs cannot be established by merely launching SST; the contract must tie the workload to the installed 1DPC map and actual address-range coverage.
removed_ambiguities: Cold margin test concerns host DDR, not GPU HBM.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 turns 'all DIMMs' into verifiable socket/channel/serial and memory-range coverage while flagging the contradictory duration metadata.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 40 specifies physical 1DPC population and all-DIMM 12-hour SST at 0 C/+5%.
